title: Winter Office timing for High Court and Sub Ordinate Courts.
text:
KEY LINES:


FULL TEXT:
(Sanj\.
Rejstra GeneraL
HIGH COURT OF JAMMU AND KASHMIR
(Office of the Registrar General at Srinagar)
NOTIFICATION
q//No: Dated:
It is hereby notified for information of all concerned that the High Court
of Jammu and Kashmir and the Courts Subordinate to it, shalt function for the
Winter Session-2019-2020, with effect from the dates and as per the time
schedule given hereunder: -
Office Hours: -
1. High Court Wing Jammu 10:00 A.M. to 05:00 P.M.
From 1st October, 2019 to 30th April, 2020
2. High Court Wing Srinagar 10:30 A.M. to 04:00 P.M
From 1st November, 2019 to 30th April, 2020
Court Hours: -
1. High Court wing Jammu
2. High Court wing Srinagar
10:30 A.M. to 01:00 P.M
02:00 P.M. to 04:30 P.M
10:30 A.M. to 01:00 P.M
02:00 P.M. to 04:00 P.M
Office timing for Subordinate Courts at Jammu/Srinagar
Jammu Province:
From 1st October, 2019 to 3O April, 2020 10:00 A.M. to 04:30 P.M.
(with lunch break from 01:00 P.M to 01:30 P.M)
(Except Courts located at Kishtwar, Batote, Banihal, Gool, Bani, Ukhral and in the Judicial
District Bhaderwah)
Kashmir Province:
From 1st November, 2019 to 30th April, 2020 10:30 A.M. to 04:30 P.M.
(with lunch break from 01:00 P.M to 01:30 P.M)
(Including Courts located at Kishtwar, Batote, Banihal, Gool, Bani, Ukhral and in the
Judicial District Bhaderwah)
By Order;
